system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. The target gains the [Aquatic] tag, and [Cancel (Aquatic): 20]. Treat this effect as a Combat Status.

(CR21): Increase the [Cancel] to 30.
(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A magic that grants the protection of water to your friends and yourself, allowing them to move freely in the water as well as on land, if not more.
